reachable_note: https://www.eurilighting.com redirects to https://www.euricompany.com/ (HTTP 200). Responses are gzip-encoded even without Accept-Encoding - decompress.
platform: Webflow CMS (Finsweet cmsfilter/cmsload); not Shopify (/products.json returns Webflow page JSON), no sitemap.xml (404), no JSON-LD; og:image present on product pages
catalog_endpoint: Listing: https://www.euricompany.com/products?feaebd7c_page=1..4 (50 cards/page; each card has fs-cmsfilter-field="sku1".."sku5" text, product href, and image). Search: https://www.euricompany.com/search?query=<SKU> (Webflow site search, server-rendered; first result is the product). Product page og:image = main image.
est_products_note: /products listing exposes 196 product cards / 253 SKUs, but the site has more product pages than the listing (e.g. DLC4G-9W105se, DLC8C-24W203swej, EUD4-50W103sw-S reachable only via search/direct URL). Total unknown.
sku_format_match: yes - sku1..sku5 fields and slugs carry Euri SKUs in the same format (case-insensitive, e.g. EOL-WL16FR-3100se). Some fixtures list a base SKU only (EIN-VL19FR-3000e listed, image named EIN-VL19FR-3000).

recommended_strategy: 1) Page https://www.euricompany.com/products?feaebd7c_page=1..4 and build SKU->(product href, card image) from sku1..sku5 fields (uppercase compare). 2) For SKUs not in the listing, GET /search?query=<SKU>, take result hrefs after "search-result-items", accept only if the slug ends with the lowercased SKU (or the page lists the SKU), then GET the product page and use og:image (skip pages returning 404). 3) Strip -EM / color suffixes as a fallback to a base-SKU page and flag as family image. ~1 req/s.
notes: Images on cdn.prod.website-files.com (Webflow CDN; .webp/.jpg/.png). Several og:images are sibling-SKU renders - keep filename-contains-SKU as quality flag. Observed 9/12 exact (7 via listing + 2 via search), 1 base-SKU only, 3 not available.
